issue.title: Federation cache-only reads report a stale cached snapshot as status ok with no error after a network failure
issue.description: Cache-only federation reads ignore the last network failure and label the stale cache ok; see the bug body for the reproduction and proposed fix.

task_type_fields.impact: A stale fleet or attention snapshot looks healthy in the TUI's cache-only refreshes. Settled remote gates can reappear as pending, and freshness chrome hides a broken owner link.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1aq.10.7.5.5 (note #2, 2026-09-27); originally sase-168 follow-up 2 and a DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-xe.16.11.7.14 (note #4), which closed on 2026-09-27 without fixing it.

Reproduced by reading linked sase-core b57cd21: in crates/sase_gateway/src/federation_worker/imp/remote_hosts.rs, `read_one_host` handles `cache_only` with `cached_or_error(&host, &cache, &cache_key, None)` (about line 491). With a cache entry and `error: None`, `cached_or_error` (about line 584) returns `payload_result("ok", true, age, payload, None)`. So after a failed network read, cache-only reads return the last good payload as `status: ok, cached: true, error: null`, while the network path returns `stale` plus the error. On 2026-09-22 this replayed a 2026-09-16 Apollo attention payload (about 499k s old) as ok on Athena and re-asserted 8 settled gates as pending (the root cause of sase-168).

Fix: record the last network failure per host and cache key, or per host, and have cache-only reads return `stale` plus that error until a later network read succeeds. Add a federation-worker test in which a network failure is followed by a cache-only read.
